explanation.text: The Logic: SDG 10 is 'Reduced Inequalities'. SDG 5 is Gender Equality, SDG 8 is Decent Work and Economic Growth, SDG 15 is Life on Land. The Trap: Option A (SDG 5) is often confused because gender equality is a form of inequality reduction — but SDG 5 is gender-specific. Option B (SDG 8) relates to work. Option D (SDG 15) relates to terrestrial ecosystems. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 6 (Frameworks) and Topic 8 (Case Studies). SAS-400 gender and inclusion engagements span both SDG 5 and SDG 10 — keep them indexed separately. Assessor's Pro-Tip: In the AIR, segregate inequalities by dimension: caste/tribe (SC/ST/OBC — SDG 10), gender (SDG 5), regional (SDG 10 + ADP), economic (SDG 1). One-line taxonomy tied to each indicator avoids the 'everything is SDG 10' trap.
